source: manuscript and supplementary six-style data augmentation workflow

templates.research_summary: Rewrite the source as a rigorous research summary for a chemistry researcher. Preserve facts and uncertainty. Return JSON with augmented_text. Source ID: {source_id}. Source: {source}
templates.graduate_tutorial: Explain the source for a graduate chemistry student, including key concepts needed to understand it. Do not add unsupported facts. Return JSON with augmented_text. Source ID: {source_id}. Source: {source}
templates.industrial_practice: Restate the source for an industrial chemistry practitioner, emphasizing operational relevance only when grounded in the source. Return JSON with augmented_text. Source ID: {source_id}. Source: {source}
templates.mechanistic_explanation: Restate the source with attention to mechanisms explicitly supported by the source. Mark uncertainty rather than inventing a mechanism. Return JSON with augmented_text. Source ID: {source_id}. Source: {source}
templates.question_led_review: Turn the source into a concise question-led explanatory passage suitable for chemistry QA generation. Keep every claim grounded. Return JSON with augmented_text. Source ID: {source_id}. Source: {source}
templates.plain_language_bridge: Explain the source in accessible language while retaining chemical accuracy and limitations. Return JSON with augmented_text. Source ID: {source_id}. Source: {source}
